conflictsOfInterest: The founder is the project maintainer. This is an internal founder review, not independent external validation.
decisionText: Apruebo la revisión interna del retest M2 de la PR #142 en el commit 520f905. Acepto la evidencia de mejora reproducible en el corpus y condiciones registrados, incluida la equivalencia de árboles y los controles de seguridad. Mantengo documentado el primer intento incompleto. La validación humana externa y el cierre de M2 siguen pendientes.
rationale: The two registered 30-pair batches met the median and bootstrap gates against serial preparation and the timed path-overlap baseline. All 60 pairs produced the same tracked tree with zero unsafe admissions and unchanged source fingerprints; four isolated test lanes passed. The earlier incomplete attempt remains excluded from the accepted result.
limits: Approval applies only to the reviewed commit and registered corpus, code, image, command, limits and tracked-tree observation contract.
The first incomplete attempt is preserved and excluded from the accepted two-batch result.
Finite tracked-tree and unit-test observations do not establish general confluence, live-agent safety or universal performance improvement.
Agent code review and passing CI do not constitute independent human validation.
